 in one line in css

In CSS, you can use the shorthand `background` property to set multiple background styles in a single line. Here's an example:

```css
background: color image position/size repeat attachment clip;
```

### Example:
```css
background: #f0f0f0 url('image.jpg') center/cover no-repeat fixed border-box;
```

### Explanation:
- `#f0f0f0`: Background color.
- `url('image.jpg')`: Background image.
- `center/cover`: Background position (`center`) and size (`cover`).
- `no-repeat`: Background repeat setting.
- `fixed`: Background attachment (fixed or scroll).
- `border-box`: Background clip (defines painting area).

This shorthand property allows you to efficiently define all background styles in one line.
using background property in onel line of code

Here’s an example of using the `background` property in one line of CSS:

```css
background: #f0f0f0 url('image.jpg') no-repeat center/cover;
```

### Explanation:
- `#f0f0f0`: Sets the background color.
- `url('image.jpg')`: Sets the background image.
- `no-repeat`: Ensures the image does not repeat.
- `center/cover`: Centers the image and makes it cover the entire background area. 

You can adjust these values based on your design needs!
